name: Appearance
summary: Creator appearance choices (S51): a tone for the head (skin, shell, bark or plating) and an accent (hair, visor, glow). Each is an id list; the placeholder rig paints them and a sprite sheet swaps its `skin` and `accent` palette roles when it has them. Empty means the race's default look. An option with `unlock_flag` is a cosmetic the account earns when a playthrough sets that flag (S62); `unlock_blurb` is shown on the creator while it is locked.

tones.name: Loom-lit
tones.unlock_blurb: Unlocked by reaching any ending in an earlier playthrough.
